hook: Your terminal programs can survive a restart

beats.say: Mitchell Hashimoto's Rex terminal can now resume your programs after a server restart, and his company Superlogical published the protocol behind it today.
It's built on a brand new open terminal protocol, OSC 7577, made with herdr and reviewed by several terminal emulator and program authors.
Any program can report how to resume using plain escape sequences, Rex ships with Claude Code support, and herdr plans to add it next.
